prompts.title: Recent Form — Kinetic Type and Grouped Count Bars
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical montage in GoatLab palette: charcoal #101412 field, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Editorial variant: kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Spanish headings Victorias, Empates, Derrotas enter as staggered slabs, each word snapping to the beat of narration; Málaga CF and Real Sociedad de Fútbol appear as opposing type columns. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Lime underline sweeps under each Spanish word; slate ghost numerals are decorative and must not imply counts. Camera pushes in on the first team name, then pans vertically across the stacked phrases. Transition: hard cut on kick-like impact, then soft dissolve into the second team column. Exit: type collapses into centre line and fades. Statistical variant: grouped count bars for wins, draws and losses over each available recent sample, shared zero baseline; unit partidos is resolved from catalogue. X-axis is common count scale; y-axis has two team groups, Málaga CF and Real Sociedad de Fútbol. Bars use warm white for home, slate for away, lime for emphasis on the leading segment per group. Labels in Spanish: Victorias, Empates, Derrotas. Values appear only as {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Source and sample annotation stay pinned under the chart: source Bzzoiro, sample sizes {{home.n}} and {{away.n}}; if the sample badges differ, show a slate warning chip. Entry animation: baseline draws first, bars grow upward with slight overshoot, then labels count up via renderer. Main comparison: side-by-side team groups. Emphasis: lime pulse on the dominant category in each group, resolved from rendered values. Camera slowly pushes toward the baseline; lower quarter remains subtitle-safe. Transition: wipe from editorial kinetic type into the statistical grid, then a vertical swipe to next scene. Exit: bars settle, labels lock, and the whole chart drifts up as subtitles continue.
